comments.value: who tryna be my roommate if this ever gets approved?
I like this idea! I currently only use my home world to calibrate then leave but this is a cool idea.

This is allready possible via  steam launch options, I am currently using it with a friend for a shared home instance.
Would definitely be more convenient to have a  way to do it in game though~
@{61624ce5189c4541da151763|full_name}: How would I go about doing that? That sounds pretty neat! Is there any documentation online?

@{602adeac1b8f79100ec2b86b|full_name}: I've not seen any documentation, but its `vrchat://launch?id=`
e.g. `vrchat://launch?id=wrld_d29bb0d0-d268-42dc-8365-926f9d485505&instanceId=34186~private(usr_55956b87-8ae0-4725-8ca0-0044f8e844cf)~canRequestInvite~region(eu)~nonce(2ef3171c-7aa6-42b2-ac2d-5c9fa05612aa)`

details: Would allow for communal home world instances!
title: Allow home worlds to be set to specific instance link/ID
